Kuvitus: radiohiililaboratorio. Pöydällä: Illustration: a radiocarbon laboratory. An old piece of wood lies on a bench as the sample. The beam formed from its carbon ions passes through a vacuum tube between the poles of a large electromagnet, curves and splits into two beams that strike two different places on the detector. The screen shows two peaks of different heights.
Kaavakuva: kaksi paneelia, joissa magnee: Formula diagram: two panels in which the magnetic field points into the page, shown by green crosses. On the left a positive particle moves to the right and the magnetic force points upwards. On the right a negative particle also moves to the right and the force points downwards. The force is perpendicular to both the velocity and the field.
Kaavakuva: positiivinen hiukkanen kiertä: Formula diagram: a positive particle moves clockwise round a circular path in a magnetic field that points out of the page (green dotted circles). At four points of the path the blue velocity arrow is along the tangent of the path and the red magnetic force arrow points towards the centre of the circle. The arrows are equally long at every point, because the speed does not change. A radius r is drawn from the centre to the path.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: ympyräradan säde: Graph drawn to scale: the radius r of the circular path in centimetres as a function of the speed v of the particle, when the magnetic field is 0.20 tesla. The line for the proton rises from the origin to 10.4 cm at a speed of 2.0 million metres per second, and the line for the deuteron twice as steeply to 20.9 cm. The radius is directly proportional to the speed and to the mass. The graph shows the radius r, not the diameter 2r.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: massaspe: Schematic diagram, not to scale: a mass spectrometer. On the left is the ion source. The ions first pass through the velocity selector: between the plates the electric field points upwards and the magnetic field out of the page, and an ion travelling straight is acted on by equal and opposite forces, the electric force upwards and the magnetic force downwards. After the slit the ions curve through a semicircle in the second magnetic field and strike the detector. The semicircle of heavier ions is larger, so they land farther from the slit. The distance of the point of impact from the slit is the diameter 2r of the path.
Kaavakuva: tyhjiökammiossa magneettikent: Formula diagram: in a vacuum chamber the magnetic field points into the page (green crosses). A particle enters from the left moving horizontally to the right, and its path curves downwards as an arc of a circle. The sign of the charge of the particle is not marked.
